subject: Orbit Labs - accelerator credit extension & packaging options
messages:
From: Saira Khan <hello@orbitlabs.ai>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: growth@hatchpartners.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Accelerator credit extension & packaging for Orbit cohort

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the founders loved the low-latency responses and the cost breakdown. Hatch (cc'd) is assembling the cohort offer and we have a question on the promo credit window.

The standard accelerator bundle we saw in the docs lists 90 days of promo credits (50k tokens). Our cohort onboarding is staggered across ~4 months and many founders will exhaust credits before the last batch goes live.

Could Redwood consider:
- extending the promo credit window to 4 months for accelerator partners, or
- offering a staged credit release (e.g., 25k on day 0, then 25k after month 1, etc.), or
- a hybrid model where unused credits can be applied to overage at a discounted rate?

This is time-sensitive as we need to finalize the MOU by end of week. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Attaching the cohort timeline for reference.

Appreciate your help — Orbit would prefer to commit to Redwood if the credits cover our staggered onboarding.

Best,
Saira Khan
Head of Growth, Orbit Labs
--
Orbit Labs | hello@orbitlabs.ai

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator credit extension & packaging for Orbit cohort

Hi Saira — thanks for the clear note and the timeline. Great to see Hatch pushing structured onboarding.

Short answer: we can support a partner-specific exception but need to agree structure and limits so finance and security are covered. Two feasible options from our side:

Option A — Staged release (recommended):
- 100k promo credits total, delivered as 25k on sign-up + 25k after month 1 + 25k after month 2 + 25k after month 3.
- Credits expire 6 months after issuance.
- Overage pricing: 20% discount on standard hosted rates for up to $5k of overage; then normal pricing.

Option B — Extended window:
- 50k promo credits with expiry set to 120 days instead of 90.
- No overage discount.

If you want additional runway we can offer a one-time top-up (finance approval required). I attached a proposed credit schedule that maps to Orbit's cohort dates.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Tell me which option you prefer (A or B) and whether Hatch needs any contractual language (MOU vs. SOW).
2) If Option A, I will loop in Marissa for partner promo approval and Ben for finance/credit cap.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call today.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead — Accelerators, Redwood Inference
--

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Orbit Labs - accelerator credit extension & packaging options

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Orbit's ask. They need an answer quickly (MOU due EOW). My recommendation is Option A (staged release, 100k total, 20% overage discount up to $5k).

Why Option A: it aligns usage with onboarding cadence for founders and reduces churn risk; plus the overage cap limits upside for us.

Please evaluate:
- Marissa: partner promo risk / precedence for cohort staged releases. Is 100k too generous relative to other accelerator partners? Could we instead do 75k with the same schedule?
- Ben: finance impact and whether the $5k overage cap is acceptable from a revenue protection POV. Also flag any billing/contract processes we must follow.

Goal: confirm a path today so I can reply to Saira and include contract language.

Thanks — Priya
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Orbit Labs - accelerator credit extension & packaging options

Priya — thanks for the context. I ran the partner precedent review. Quick notes:

- We have done staged releases for educational partners but only up to 75k total for cohort programs. 100k is higher than our standard but not unprecedented for strategic partners that drive volume.
- Proposal: offer 100k on the condition that Orbit: 1) lists Redwood as preferred infra partner in their cohort materials, and 2) schedules a co-branded 45-min workshop/demo for founders within the first 6 weeks. That gives us marketing lift and visibility.
- Alternative compromise: 80k staged (20k / 20k / 20k / 20k) and a 15% overage discount with a $3k cap. This reduces downside and still helps the cohort.

I've attached a short credit-impact summary that models unit economics for both the 100k and 80k variants (assumes median founder uses 12k tokens/mo).

I lean toward the 80k + 15% discount ($3k cap) as an easy approval path. If Orbit pushes, escalate and we can consider the 100k with the marketing commitments.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
--
attachment: credit-impact-summary.pdf (pdf)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Orbit Labs - accelerator credit extension & packaging options

All — quick finance POV.

- 80k staged with 15% overage discount capped at $3k: OK from a risk perspective. Low probability of >$3k overage across the cohort given usage profile, and marketing commitments mitigate CAC.
- 100k staged with 20% overage discount capped $5k: conditional approval — require signed MOU and a documented marketing deliverable before top-up is issued. Also ask legal to add a clause preventing transfer of credits between external organizations.

Let me know which path you want to present; I'll route billing and set up the promo code mechanics once confirmed.

Ben Carter
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
